title: OptiBolt
body:
![OptiBolt cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01c923dd824c087ea338a5140cc6ffbc8854447f.png)

OptiBolt is a modpack that focuses solely on optimizing vanilla Minecraft without adding new features for those who prefer the vanilla experience. The modpack is based on Simple Optimized with my own modifications that further improve performance.

Now you are about to see a comparison in two different situations

![Comparison 1 (normal)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/727978e757bda1a3e0b4f372c384569dab309599.png)

![Comparison 1 (tnt)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c579bdd99c2d01abca4f821f43e2a77942857d5.png)
